messages:
Cara S.: FYI handing off AtlasHealth (enterprise, HIPAA) — signed 2024-03-28. Primary ask: private deployment in us-east-1 on dedicated capacity (2x A10G equiv). SSO via Okta + SCIM. Legal review still outstanding (expected ~2 weeks). Trial window 30d; they want initial demo + enablement week of 2024-04-12. Renewal risk is high if onboarding slips past trial. Sales notes: they will provide a sanitized dataset for early eval. Sales committed token budget up to $X/mo for the trial. Links: contract doc + 1Password creds shared. CS to own kickoff; Support/Eng to own infra runbook & private deploy. @Mike C. you own CS kickoff. @Jen S. own support triage. @Alex G. engineering lead for private deploy.

Mike C.: Got it. I'll create the onboarding ticket with milestones and owners. Need Okta dev access + SCIM test tenant creds and sample prompts for the eval harness. Planning to schedule kickoff EOD 2024-03-29.

Cara S.: Shared Okta dev link + 1P path: https://1password.com/... (shared to Mike/Jen/Priya). Contract: https://drive.redwood/atlas-contract. Sales note: customer will share sanitized dataset and a list of critical business flows.

Priya R.: I'll run enablement: 2 sessions (admin/setup, prompt engineering + evals). Please add 8-10 "critical prompts" to the ticket and acceptance criteria (latency + quality). I'll prepare a short eval harness for those prompts.

Jen S.: Support triage plan — I'll create infra checklist: certs, network CIDR, routing/peering, KMS access, monitor hooks. Quick confirm: HSM required? Cara said "optional" — legal to confirm. Preliminary network values: CIDR 10.10.0.0/16, peering IPs TBD. Tagging @Alex G for quantization/profile decisions.

Alex G.: Eng update — we'll provision a private cluster template and a deploy runbook. Need expected sequence length distribution and peak concurrency to tune kernels. For the perf target (p95 <=200ms) we'll baseline on 2 GPUs. @Mike C. please add workload details to the ticket; I'll open an infra PR with fallback to hosted model variants.

Mike C.: Added workload to ticket CS-4821: peak demo QPS 10-20, typical seq 256 tokens, occasional long jobs ~1k tokens. Also added sanitized dataset link and contact at AtlasHealth.

Priya R.: For enablement—I'll need 8-10 customer prompts + acceptance criteria (example: latency p95 <200ms, relevance score >=0.7). Who is owning the eval metrics? Suggest we store a small reference eval in the repo and run it during the demo.

Jen S.: Support action items: open VPN/peering request, request certs from customer, create KMS access ticket. Also flagging renewal risk if legal/SSO delayed >2 weeks — I'll set an internal SLA and escalation at 14 days.

Mike C.: Owners & next steps summary:
- CS kickoff & schedule (Mike C.) — due 2024-03-29
- Enablement sessions + eval harness (Priya R.) — due 2024-04-09
- Infra runbook + private deploy PR (Alex G.) — due 2024-04-05
- Support: network, certs, KMS (Jen S.) — due 2024-04-03
- Legal signature/terms (Sales) — tracking by Cara
I'll post weekly status updates in this thread. :thumbsup:

Cara S.: :thumbsup: Thanks all — I'll keep nudging legal and the customer on timelines. Ping me if blockers.
